title: Perfect matchings in planar 3-connected graphs: girth five and minimum degree five
summary: Let $Φ(G)$ denote the number of perfect matchings of a graph $G$. Goedgebeur et al. posted two questions about the perfect matchings of planar 3-connected graphs: does there exist an infinite family of matchable planar 3-connected graphs of girth 5 with a constant number of perfect matchings? Whether there exist infinitely many planar 3-connected graphs with minimum degree 5 which have a constant number of perfect matchings. We present answers to those questions.
